title: Agent chat: persist history across nav/refresh + multi-thread support (new/switch/clear)
description: USER FEATURE: agent chat history is lost when navigating off the Agent tab and on refresh; add persistence + threads. Today AgentChatPanel.tsx keeps conversation state in component state, so it's lost on unmount (tab switch) and on reload. REQUIREMENTS: (1) Lift chat state out of AgentChatPanel into a persisted store (new packages/authoring-ui/src/agentchat/threadStore.ts — a zustand store, or mirror preferences.ts) so history survives leaving/returning to the Agent tab AND a full page refresh (persist to localStorage). (2) THREADS: support multiple conversation threads — each {id, title, messages (the ModelMessage[] history + the rendered transcript), createdAt, updatedAt}. Maintain an activeThreadId. (3) UI in the Agent panel: a thread switcher (list/dropdown of past threads, most-recent first, showing title + timestamp), a 'New thread' / 'New chat' button (starts an empty thread), select-to-switch (restores that thread's transcript), and Clear/Delete (delete a thread; 'Clear' the current one). Derive a thread title from the first user message (truncated), default 'New chat'. (4) Persistence hygiene: cap stored size (e.g. max N threads / trim very large transcripts) to avoid localStorage quota issues; handle parse/quota failures gracefully (mirror preferences.ts try/catch). (5) Preserve everything from the existing panel: markdown rendering (task 1290), streaming, thinking/tool chips, Stop, settings (key/model), and text-selectability (1285). An in-flight run should write into the active thread. VERIFY ground truth first (current AgentChatPanel state/history handling — note response.messages multi-turn history). TEST: store round-trips threads through localStorage (mock); creating/switching/clearing/deleting threads; restoring active thread on remount; title derivation. Build + authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable); agent-chat e2e oracle still passes. Update docs/32-agent-chat.md. ACQUIRE lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: new threadStore.ts + AgentChatPanel.tsx + docs/32. NOTE: SEQUENCED AFTER task 1290 (markdown) which is concurrently editing AgentChatPanel.tsx — build on its merged result.
